title: Effect of H3PO4 coordination on vanadium extraction and iron separation in a H2SO4 leaching system
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37404-37418
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06632D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuxia Zhao, Yimin Zhang, Nannan Xue, Pengcheng Hu, Qiushi Zheng
A novel complex acid leaching route for extracting V is proposed. The selectivity of the H3PO4–H2SO4 system is superior to H2SO4. Fe3+ coordinated with PO43− to reduce Fe impurity; H3PO4–H2SO4 leaching separated the V and Fe.
